label.answer_summary: The report identified that plant owners worked with inverter manufacturers to apply known improvements to ride-through settings, and after the event, some larger facilities adjusted inverters to not trip on the same behaviors, reducing active power injection instead, improving recovery times to two to three minutes.
label.rationale: s012 states the joint team recommended ride-through improvements; s017 and s018 describe the implemented mitigation of adjusting inverter settings to avoid tripping, improving recovery times.
